name: Custom Furniture & Design LLC
old_description: Built with skill, care, and decades of experience; custom furniture and cabinetry designed to last for generations.
about:
Custom Furniture & Design LLC has operated from Bantam, Connecticut since its founding in 1989. The company was established as a woodworking shop serving the surrounding region and has remained in the same location for over three decades.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, bespoke furniture, and architectural millwork for residential projects. Using traditional joinery and hand-selected premium hardwoods, the team fabricates kitchen systems, bathroom vanities, built-in storage, dining tables, sideboards, bedroom suites, library shelving, coffered ceilings, wainscoting, and custom entryways. All work moves from raw lumber through finishing and installation in-house, with no outsourced fabrication.

Clients include homeowners, interior designers, architects, and builders across Litchfield County, Fairfield County, and Lower Westchester. The company collaborates on projects ranging from whole-kitchen suites to individual furniture pieces, working from client drawings or developing details jointly.

The firm emphasizes single-source accountability: design, build, and installation are handled by the same crew, ensuring that each piece fits the specific architecture of the home rather than adapting catalog dimensions. This approach was built on the premise that cabinetry should be made for the space, not pulled from a standard line.
